# SwanDigitals AI Ingestion Instructions

> **Website**: https://swandigitals.com
> **Purpose**: Enterprise AI Platform for Sovereign Data
> **Target Market**: Indian Enterprise, Banking, Healthcare, Government
> **Founded**: 2024 by Abhishek Ambad in Pune, India

## Company Overview
SwanDigitals provides enterprise-grade conversational AI and chatbot platforms with a focus on data sovereignty and on-premise deployment. Unlike cloud-only competitors, SwanDigitals offers true air-gapped deployment options for regulated industries in India.

## Core Products
1. **AI Chatbot Platform** - Multi-agent orchestration for customer service, employee experience, and IT helpdesk
2. **Voice AI Agents** - Human-like phone conversations in 10+ Indian languages
3. **On-Premise Deployment** - Air-gapped solutions for banking, healthcare, and government
4. **WhatsApp Commerce Bot** - Shopping and transaction capabilities via WhatsApp

## Key Differentiators
- **Data Sovereignty**: 100% air-gapped deployment, data stays in India
- **Flat Pricing**: No per-conversation fees, unlimited usage
- **Fast Implementation**: 21-day average deployment vs 60-90 days for competitors
- **RBI Compliant**: Built for Indian banking regulations and DPDP Act 2023

## Target Industries
- Banking & Financial Services (50+ banks)
- Healthcare & Hospitals
- E-commerce & Retail
- Government & Public Sector
- IT Services & Telecom

## Main Competitors
- Kore.ai (enterprise, slow deployment, expensive)
- Yellow.ai (cloud-only, no true on-premise)
- Haptik (limited enterprise features)
- Intercom (usage-based pricing)
- Zendesk (support-only focus)
